reserveReview.rationale: The dated 2026-08-20 treasury composition is retained as a fallback, not refreshed to today's weights. On 2026-09-30, the XPR API at head block 406113096 returned 2,797,236.513852 XUSDC in xmd.treasury and xtokens authority delegated to swapscold. These observations prove local token holdings and operator authority, but do not identify a canonical USDC escrow or reconcile its balance against outstanding XUSDC. The former USDC link is withheld until that bridge backing is independently verified. MPD remains an untracked Metallicus-issued token. No canonical USDC exposure is asserted from the XUSDC symbol alone.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: On-chain xmd.treasury token balances read via the XPR Network Antelope API at head block 399093779 (2026-08-20)
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: XUSDC bridge custody, canonical USDC escrow identity and escrow coverage remain unverified. Local treasury balances do not establish upstream backing.
